listing.title: Applied listing symbol
listing.detail: The company applied to list Class A common stock on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas under the symbol SPCX.

basis.title: Recast financial basis
basis.detail: Financial statements are retrospectively recast for the xAI merger, X merger and five-for-one stock split effective May 4, 2026.

voting.title: Dual-class voting
voting.detail: Class A has one vote per share, Class B has ten votes per share and Class C has no voting rights; Class B holders separately elect 51% of the board while any Class B shares remain outstanding.

muskControl.title: Musk voting power before offering
muskControl.detail: Elon Musk is shown with 849,494,440 Class A shares, 5,569,053,075 Class B shares and 85.1% combined voting power before the offering in the beneficial ownership table.

controlledCompany.title: Controlled company status
controlledCompany.detail: The filing says SpaceX will be a controlled company under Nasdaq/Nasdaq Texas rules after the offering and intends to rely on certain governance exemptions.

muskRemoval.title: Removal of Musk from leadership roles
muskRemoval.detail: Removal of Mr. Musk from the board and from CEO/Chairman leadership roles requires approval of holders of at least a majority of the voting power of outstanding Class B common stock voting separately as a class.
